```{r}
# Clean gene symbols (remove version suffix if present)

expr_data$gene_id <- gsub("\\|.*", "", expr_data$gene_id)

  separate(gene_id, into = c("gene_symbol", "entrez_id"), sep = "\\|")
```

```{r}
# If expr_raw is a SummarizedExperiment or similar, convert first
expr_data <- as.data.frame(expr_raw)

# Separate gene ID column into gene symbol and entrez_id
expr_data_clean <- expr_data %>%
  tidyr::separate(gene_id, into = c("gene_symbol", "entrez_id"), sep = "\\|")

# Remove duplicate gene symbols by keeping the first occurrence
expr_data_nodup <- expr_data_clean %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
```

```{r}
expr_tidy <- expr_data_nodup %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_symbol") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("barcode")
```

```{r}
# Clean up barcodes (skip first row which is header info)
clean_barcodes <- gsub("\\.", "-", expr_tidy[-1, 1])  # Replace "." with "-"
clean_barcodes <- sapply(strsplit(clean_barcodes, "-"), function(x) paste(x[1:3], collapse = "-"))

# Apply cleaned barcodes
expr_tidy[-1, 1] <- clean_barcodes  # Replace original barcodes in column 1 (assuming it's named 'barcode')

# Optional: Rename the first column to make it clearer
colnames(expr_tidy)[1] <- "barcode"

# Check the result
head(expr_tidy[, 1:5])
```

```{r}
# Clean merged_filtered for survival modeling
merged_filtered_clean <- merged_filtered %>%
  filter(!is.na(OS.time), !is.na(OS), OS.time > 0)

merged_filtered_pfi_clean <- merged_filtered %>%
  filter(!is.na(PFI.time), !is.na(PFI), PFI.time > 0)

# Check result
nrow(merged_filtered)
summary(merged_filtered_clean$OS.time)
```


```{r}
# Subset and clean expression matrix
x <- as.matrix(merged_filtered_clean[, genes_of_interest])
x <- apply(x, 2, as.numeric)
x <- log2(x + 1)

# Create survival object
y_os <- Surv(merged_filtered_clean$OS.time, merged_filtered_clean$OS)
```

```{r}
# Subset and convert expression matrix to numeric and log-transform
x_pfi <- as.matrix(merged_filtered_pfi_clean[, genes_of_interest])
x_pfi <- apply(x_pfi, 2, as.numeric)
x_pfi <- log2(x_pfi + 1)

# Create PFI survival object
y_pfs <- Surv(merged_filtered_pfi_clean$PFI.time, merged_filtered_pfi_clean$PFI)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(x)), size = 0.75 * nrow(x))
x_train <- x[train_idx, ]
x_test  <- x[-train_idx, ]
y_train_os <- y_os[train_idx]
y_test_os  <- y_os[-train_idx]
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
train_idx_pfi <- sample(seq_len(nrow(x_pfi)), size = 0.75 * nrow(x_pfi))
x_train_pfi <- x_pfi[train_idx_pfi, ]
x_test_pfi  <- x_pfi[-train_idx_pfi, ]
y_train_pfs <- y_pfs[train_idx_pfi]
y_test_pfs  <- y_pfs[-train_idx_pfi]

```

```{r}
lasso_os <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train_os, family = "cox", alpha = 1, nfolds = 10)
```

```{r}
lasso_pfs <- cv.glmnet(x_train_pfi, y_train_pfs, family = "cox", alpha = 1, nfolds = 10)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Fit Elastic Net models (alpha optimized from 0.05 to 0.95)
alphas <- seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.05)
find_best_model <- function(x_train, y) {
  best_model <- NULL
  best_cvm <- Inf
  for (a in alphas) {
    cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y, family = "cox", alpha = a, nfolds = 10)
    if (min(cv_fit$cvm) < best_cvm) {
      best_model <- cv_fit
      best_cvm <- min(cv_fit$cvm)
    }
  }
  return(best_model)
}

enet_os  <- find_best_model(x_train, y_train_os)
enet_pfs <- find_best_model(x_train_pfi, y_train_pfs)
```


```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Extract non-zero coefficients
get_nonzero_coefs <- function(model, gene_names) {
  coefs <- coef(model, s = "lambda.min")
  coefs_df <- data.frame(
    Gene = gene_names[coefs@i + 1],
    Coefficient = coefs@x
  )
  coefs_df
}
```


```{r, echo=FALSE}
lasso_os_coefs   <- get_nonzero_coefs(lasso_os, colnames(x))
lasso_pfs_coefs  <- get_nonzero_coefs(lasso_pfs, colnames(x))
enet_os_coefs    <- get_nonzero_coefs(enet_os, colnames(x))
enet_pfs_coefs   <- get_nonzero_coefs(enet_pfs, colnames(x))
```


```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Plotting function
plot_coefs <- function(df, title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Coefficient, y = reorder(Gene, Coefficient))) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = Coefficient, yend = Gene), color = "gray") +
    labs(title = title, y = "Gene", x = "Coefficient") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```


```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Combine plots
library(gridExtra)
grid.arrange(
  plot_coefs(lasso_pfs_coefs, "LASSO Cox regression coefficients for PFS"),
  plot_coefs(lasso_os_coefs, "LASSO Cox regression coefficients for OS"),
  plot_coefs(enet_pfs_coefs, "Elastic Net Cox regression coefficients for PFS"),
  plot_coefs(enet_os_coefs, "Elastic Net Cox regression coefficients for OS"),
  ncol = 2 #PFS left column, OS right column 
)
```

#Predict & rescale risk scores for each model
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Predict risk scores
predict_rescale <- function(model, x_test) {
  raw_scores <- predict(model, newx = x_test, s = "lambda.min", type = "link")
  rescaled <- (raw_scores - min(raw_scores)) / (max(raw_scores) - min(raw_scores))
  return(as.vector(rescaled))
}
```


```{r, echo=FALSE}
test_data_os <- data.frame(
  OS_time = merged_filtered_clean$OS.time[-train_idx],
  OS_event = merged_filtered_clean$OS[-train_idx],
  lasso_os_score = predict_rescale(lasso_os, x_test),
  enet_os_score = predict_rescale(enet_os, x_test)
)
```

```{r}
# Stratify using surv_cutpoint & plot KM curves
make_km_plot <- function(data, time, event, score, label) {
  df <- data[, c(time, event, score)]
  colnames(df) <- c("time", "event", "score")

  cut <- surv_cutpoint(df, time = "time", event = "event", variables = "score")
  df$risk_group <- surv_categorize(cut)$score

  surv_fit <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ risk_group, data = df)

  ggsurvplot(surv_fit,
             data = df,
             pval = TRUE,
             risk.table = TRUE,
             palette = c("#1f78b4", "#e31a1c"),
             legend.labs = c("Low", "High"),
             title = paste("KM Curve:", label))
}

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
```


```{r}
extract_cox_stats <- function(cox_model, score_name, n) {
  tidy_cox <- broom::tidy(cox_model)
  row <- tidy_cox %>% filter(term == score_name)
  
  beta <- row$estimate
  se <- row$std.error
  pval <- row$p.value
  
  hr <- exp(beta * 0.1)
  lower <- exp((beta - 1.96 * se) * 0.1)
  upper <- exp((beta + 1.96 * se) * 0.1)
  
  data.frame(
    Model = score_name,
    HR = hr,
    Lower_CI = lower,
    Upper_CI = upper,
    p_value = pval,
    n = n
  )
}

# Example: get sample sizes from your test_data_os and test_data_pfs (or however named)
n_os <- nrow(test_data_os)   # samples for OS models
n_pfs <- nrow(test_data_pfi) # samples for PFS models

# Extract stats for each model
hr_lasso_os  <- extract_cox_stats(cox_lasso_os, "lasso_os_score", n_os)
hr_lasso_pfs <- extract_cox_stats(cox_lasso_pfs, "lasso_pfs_score", n_pfs)
hr_enet_os   <- extract_cox_stats(cox_enet_os, "enet_os_score", n_os)
hr_enet_pfs  <- extract_cox_stats(cox_enet_pfs, "enet_pfs_score", n_pfs)

# Combine all
hr_df <- bind_rows(hr_lasso_os, hr_lasso_pfs, hr_enet_os, hr_enet_pfs)

# Clean Model names
hr_df$Model <- recode(hr_df$Model,
                      lasso_os_score = "LASSO OS",
                      lasso_pfs_score = "LASSO PFS",
                      enet_os_score = "Elastic Net OS",
                      enet_pfs_score = "Elastic Net PFS")

# Format p-values for display
hr_df <- hr_df %>%
  mutate(p_label = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", p_value)),
         n_label = paste0("n = ", n),
         label = paste0("HR = ", round(HR, 2), "\n", 
                        "95% CI: [", round(Lower_CI, 2), "-", round(Upper_CI, 2), "]\n",
                        "p ", p_label, "\n", n_label))

```

```{r}
ggplot(hr_df, aes(x = Model, y = HR)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower_CI, ymax = Upper_CI), width = 0.2, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  ylim(min(hr_df$Lower_CI)*0.8, max(hr_df$Upper_CI)*1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Hazard Ratios per 0.1 Increase in Spatial Connectivity Score",
    subtitle = "With 95% Confidence Intervals, p-values and Sample Sizes",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Hazard Ratio (HR)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```
